This is a senior-level Software Engineer role at Kreative Technologies, a fully remote position focused on designing and building scalable backend software systems. The work spans architecture design, production code development, technical and code reviews, and mentoring other engineers, with salary listed at $85,850–$95,389 per year. The core stack is Java, C#, and Python, with microservices and cloud platforms (AWS and Azure), alongside relational databases, APIs, Git, and CI/CD pipelines.
